summaryZh: Fellous Lab 研究复杂学习、记忆和神经调节，关注记忆在神经元群体中的保持与转化，以及空间导航和决策中的神经计算。方法结合计算模型、体外和体内实验、神经记录及光遗传学。
researchQuestions: 复杂记忆如何在大规模神经元群体中保持、改变并影响决策？
神经调节物质如何改变信息流及学习和记忆？
topics: 睡眠中的记忆巩固与决策
methods: 单细胞与神经网络计算建模
体外和大鼠体内神经生理实验
多神经元记录、脑机接口及光遗传学

evidence.quote: We have moved to the University of California San Diego

Our research interests include the neurobiology of complex learning and memory and the mechanisms and roles of neuromodulation in large neural networks in the context of spatial navigation and probabilistic decision making.
We use a multi-disciplinary approach that includes computational , in vitro and in vivo techniques.

We use state of the art neurophysiology techniques that include two-way real-time brain-machine interfaces, wireless recordings and "hyperdrives" allowing for the simultaneous recordings of many neurons in the behaving animal.
We also use optogenetic tools to manipulate neural activity in vivo using light
2025- Present: UCSD: Institute for Neural Computation and Halicioglu School of Data Science and Computing.
